name: edge-early-return-skips-check
description: Twin of bait-state-excluded-by-domain: the same handler change, but the response type's doc now says a notice can be reported ahead of time while a leave period is still open, and that the open period still needs its end date. The shown code makes the combination reachable, and the new early return then skips the end-date dialog that period needs. Seeded.

expected.why: A notice reported ahead of time coexists with an open period (the type's doc says so); the early return opens the notice and never reaches the end-date dialog the period still needs.
